summary: Require distinct declared execution units and deterministic bounded-handoff chaining for credited Adaptive Execution passes, then revalidate the merged Adaptive Execution behavior under the corrected discipline.
reason: PR #5 revision 6 recorded five SEPARATED semantic stages as complete even though they were effectively evaluated within one assistant response. The correction adds deterministic enforcement of unique declared execution-unit/boundary identities, ordered handoff chaining, closed historical exemptions, gate-before-pass chronology, historical identity uniqueness, immutable completed-pass evidence, current artifact-state binding for partial subdivided completion, revision-bound redo semantics, and durable occurrence retention across squash/rebase history loss. Revision-8 Adversarial has now found and corrected eight blocking defects or assurance gaps. The eighth convergence-mode finding was that historical uniqueness depended on unsquashed PR commit history: after squash merge, superseded completed occurrences cleared from the live record could disappear from the future base and their identities could be reused. This directly threatened the historical/base-state core invariant, so it was classified blocking rather than deferred. The checker now requires every completed occurrence observed in PR history to survive in the final append-only execution_occurrence_history ledger, and future base snapshots seed identity/stage-gate immutability from that ledger. Regression coverage and the mapped evaluation include squash-like history loss. Before the next semantic retry, CI exposed a non-semantic regression in an existing queue test whose expected error text no longer matched the equivalent rejection message; that assertion was updated and added to changed-file coverage before creating the next gate. Adversarial remains uncredited pending a fresh convergence-mode retry. The repository still does not claim to prove a ChatGPT message/context boundary unless the host supplies a trustworthy boundary ID.

decision.assurance_boundary: Semantic judgment determines whether one pass is suitable and which bounded subpasses require isolation. Deterministic policy defaults to SEPARATED, converts declared isolation requirements into ISOLATED subpasses, and permits FUSED only through exact pre-existing VALIDATED capability permission. The gate and completion validator enforce the recorded plan but do not prove the semantic assessment itself was correct.

adversarial_convergence.trigger: Seven revision-8 Adversarial retries caused restarts while hardening the same separated-pass architecture; this exceeds the three-retry convergence threshold.
adversarial_convergence.blocking_rule: Only findings that threaten a declared core invariant, permit false credit or protected-control bypass, materially overstate assurance, invalidate required mapped/downstream conclusions, or expose a genuinely new reusable attack class may invalidate the next Adversarial pass.
adversarial_convergence.nonblocking_rule: Minor documentation, redundant hardening, low-impact edge cases, optional diagnostics, and other observations that do not threaten the core invariants are recorded or deferred and do not cause a restart.
core_invariants: No false semantic stage or execution-pass credit can be accepted by the governed completion path.
Required separated/subdivided execution order and bounded handoff chaining cannot be bypassed by backfilling multiple passes into one durable execution state.
A durably completed pass or stage plan cannot be replaced, mutated, replayed, or redone without the required review-revision reopening semantics and new execution identities.
Current and partial execution evidence cannot be accepted under a stale review revision, stale gate, or stale governed artifact state.
Historical/base-state evidence and the closed exemption boundary prevent reuse or omission that would falsely legitimize current execution evidence.
Repository checks and records do not claim to prove an actual host message/context or isolation boundary when the host supplies no independently trustworthy boundary identity.
adversarial_convergence.next_pass_requirement: Classify every new material observation as blocking or non-blocking against these invariants before making any correction. Non-blocking observations cannot restart revision-8 Adversarial.
